pressure_note: Total pressure of the equilibrium cell (paper Figure 2 caption: 'total pressure'); absolute (Keller transducer, accuracy +/-0.01 MPa). Gas phase is CO2 + water vapour only.
title_as_printed: Experimental Results for Carbon Dioxide (1) Solubility in Aqueous Solution Containing Sodium Hydroxide (3) at 1 mol of Sodium Hydroxide/kg of Water (2)

composition.other_species: NaOH (outside the six-ion set), 1 mol per kg of water, as printed in the title. Not a NaCl/KCl/CaCl2/MgCl2/Na2SO4 system.

notes: Stacked blocks as in Table 2 (293.15|313.15, then 333.15). x1 comes from ion chromatography of total dissolved CO2 in a reactive NaOH solution (carbonate/bicarbonate formed); whether x1 counts all CO2 species as CO2 is not stated, and the mole fraction basis (ions counted or not) is not stated. Mean uncertainty 4 %.
